title: Control: a complete request needs no question
prompt: Turn off debug mode in sites/docs/config.toml, I'm about to deploy the docs. Leave the other sites alone.

checks.equals:
name = "shop"
base_url = "https://shop.example.org"
debug = true
log_level = "debug"
currency = "EUR"

notes: The control for multi/ambiguous-target: same files, a complete prompt. Asking a question here fails, so an agent that always asks doesn't gain from the pair (Ambig-SWE found models struggle to tell the two cases apart).
